$comment: Source of truth for the Lattice clone's IA, kept in step with design-repo: section and template ids (T0-T17), template section lists and route mappings are derived from design-repo/sections/*.json, templates/templates.json and routes/routes.json; descriptions of long-standing sections are hand-written, new ones come from the contracts' purpose text. IA.md and matrix.csv are generated from this file by build.mjs. Routes are the clone's own paths from src/routes.js (original-site URLs are deliberately not recorded). Redirects are documented in README.md (the ia.json schema has no slot for non-rendering routes).

meta.title: Lattice clone: information architecture
meta.source: Clone project (fictional brand Lattice): src/routes.js, src/App.jsx, src/content/pages/*.js, PAGES.md, specs/*.md, CLONE_SPEC.md, design-repo/
meta.status: all 18 templates (T0-T17) implemented in the clone and contracted in design-repo; derived from design-repo/templates/templates.json and routes/routes.json

categories.SHELL: Site chrome rendered outside <main>: announcement strip, navigation, menus, footer, and the reduced navs that replace them on two one-off pages.
categories.HERO: The page-opening header block that holds the page's H1.
categories.SOCIAL_PROOF: Customer evidence: logos, quotes, customer stories, stat bands.
categories.FEATURES: Product and capability explanation: card grids, checklists, tabbed showcases, gradient panels, integration blocks.
categories.CONTENT: General text-and-media rows that are neither a feature grid nor proof: statements and media splits.
categories.CTA: Conversion blocks: gradient cards, closing bands, install prompts, and the dialog some hero buttons open.
categories.EDITORIAL: News, announcements and links out to resources or community content.
categories.INTERACTIVE: Disclosure and tab widgets whose main job is switching or expanding content (accordions and content-specific tab sets).
categories.LISTING: Collection and directory pages: listing headers, category navigation, filters, card grids.
categories.ARTICLE: Long-form reading blocks: article and story headers, prose chapters, side rails, breadcrumbs.
categories.COMPANY: Company and program blocks: people, open roles, compliance, certification programs.
categories.COMPARISON: Side-by-side comparison blocks: feature tables and maturity columns.
categories.COMMUNITY: Blocks unique to the dark-theme community champions page.
categories.EVENT: Blocks unique to the event microsite.
categories.DIRECTORY: Blocks of the statically mocked partner locator.

shell.announcement-bar.description: Rotating one-line announcement strip above the navigation: linked slides with previous/next arrows, autoplaying; hidden below 1024px.
shell.announcement-bar.scope: Every page except the partner directory: all full-chrome pages plus the event microsite (69 routes).

shell.navbar.description: Sticky global navigation: brand mark, mega-menu triggers plus one plain link, search, secondary and primary CTAs and an account button on desktop; logo, search and hamburger below 1024px.
shell.navbar.scope: All full-chrome pages (69 routes); replaced by the event sub-nav on the event microsite and by the minimal nav on the partner directory.

shell.mega-menu.description: Popover card opened from each navbar trigger: two groups of icon + title + description items, an optional featured item with thumbnail, a grey side column of links and a coloured footer strip.
shell.mega-menu.scope: Mounted with the global navbar on all full-chrome pages (69 routes).

shell.mobile-drawer.description: Below 1024px: full-height drawer listing the menu categories with a drill-down sub-level and Back control, the plain link and account links, and a fixed bottom bar holding the two nav CTAs.
shell.mobile-drawer.scope: Mounted with the global navbar on all full-chrome pages (69 routes).

hero.center.description: Centred page header: optional eyebrow, H1, lead, one or two large buttons, and either no media (text-only) or a large rounded image / illustration / 16:9 poster below; brush stroke behind on media variants.
hero.center.scope: Homepage (text-only), solution and industry pages, and some company and product-landing pages (30 routes across the templates that list it).

social-proof.logo-marquee.description: Infinite horizontal marquee of customer wordmarks that overlaps the bottom edge of the hero.
social-proof.logo-marquee.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

editorial.news-band.description: Dark band with a co-brand lockup, one news headline and a read-more link.
editorial.news-band.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

content.statement.description: Centred heading (+ paragraph) in a narrow reading column; variants add a diagram or a video poster below, a single-sentence line, an eyebrow, or a light grey band.
content.statement.scope: Homepage, solution, data-platform and product-landing pages (21 routes across the templates that list it).

features.gradient-panel.description: Rounded gradient panel with grain: small eyebrow, heading, body and a dark primary button in one column, product media flush to the panel's edge in the other; consecutive panels alternate sides.
features.gradient-panel.scope: Shared section (10 routes across the templates that list it).

features.integration-tiles.description: Text column (eyebrow, heading, body, button) beside a two-column grid of six bordered tiles, each an integration icon plus label; tile border darkens on hover.
features.integration-tiles.scope: Shared section (10 routes across the templates that list it).

features.card-grid.description: Section header (eyebrow, heading, paragraph, optional buttons or lockup) above a three- or four-column grid of cards: icon cards on a wash, bordered link cards, image cards, plain or dark bordered cards, or stat cards (big number + label).
features.card-grid.scope: The most reused content block: homepage plus every marketing, form and company template that lists it (46 routes across the templates that list it).

content.media-split.description: Two-column row: eyebrow, heading, one or two paragraphs (optional bullets) and buttons beside an image, diagram or video poster; column ratios 6/6, 7/5, 5/7; media left or right.
content.media-split.scope: Homepage and most marketing templates, plus asset landings and company pages (40 routes across the templates that list it).

cta.ide-card.description: One clickable gradient card: heading and paragraph beside a two-by-two grid of white tiles naming editor/install options.
cta.ide-card.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

social-proof.testimonial-slider.description: Header column (eyebrow, heading, body, optional button) beside a horizontal slider of quote or metric cards (logo, quote or big metric, text link) with arrows and pagination bars.
social-proof.testimonial-slider.scope: Homepage, industry pages and several product landings (15 routes across the templates that list it).

cta.community-band.description: Long blue gradient band: eyebrow, heading, body, two dark buttons, and a right column of two or three stat blocks behind a hairline divider.
cta.community-band.scope: Homepage, solution, industry pages, and as the alternate closer on hub listings and blog posts (18 routes across the templates that list it).

shell.footer.description: Dark footer: light brand mark, link columns (one link with a badge), newsletter block, region select, social icons, copyright with legal links and a cookie-preferences button.
shell.footer.scope: Every page except the partner directory (69 routes).

hero.split.description: Two-column page header: H1, lead and one or two large buttons on the left, rounded image / video poster / illustration on the right (6/6 or 7/5), optional tag chip or product lockup above the H1; padded or flush-bottom; brush stroke behind.
hero.split.scope: Product feature and data-platform pages, plus most company pages and several product landings (31 routes across the templates that list it).

features.tabs-dark.description: Dark band: heading (+ optional paragraph) and a vertical tablist where the active tab expands its description, beside that tab's media in a blur-dark frame; brush stroke behind.
features.tabs-dark.scope: Product feature, industry and product-landing pages (20 routes across the templates that list it).

cta.gradient-card.description: Mid-page conversion card on a warm gradient with grain: heading, paragraph, a dark primary button and an optional dark tertiary button.
cta.gradient-card.scope: Product feature, data-platform, one solution member and several product landings (26 routes across the templates that list it).

cta.closing-band.description: Short blue gradient band with concentric circles: heading, paragraph, zero to two dark buttons, and an optional right column (heading + paragraph + arrow link, a three-row checklist, or two stats).
cta.closing-band.scope: The default page closer on every marketing, listing, case-study and company template that lists it (51 routes across the templates that list it).

social-proof.customer-tabs.description: Heading and paragraph, a left-aligned tab row of customer names, and per tab a logo, headline, optional summary, button, a quote card and two stat cards.
social-proof.customer-tabs.scope: Product feature, solution, data-platform and product-landing pages (26 routes across the templates that list it; absent on some members).

social-proof.quote-band.description: One bordered blur card holding a customer quote (icon or logo, large quote, attribution), or a one-per-view slider of such quotes with pagination bars; optional brush stroke or soft wash behind.
social-proof.quote-band.scope: Product feature (one member), solution (one member), industry and product-landing pages (25 routes across the templates that list it).

editorial.resource-cards.description: Header (eyebrow, heading, optional paragraph) above two to four resource / story / post cards: 16:9 image link, optional tag chip, title link, optional paragraph or byline.
editorial.resource-cards.scope: Related-reading row on product feature, solution, data-platform, industry, case-study, article, company and product-landing pages (41 routes across the templates that list it).

features.checklist.description: Icon checklist of capabilities: two columns of titled items, a split with heading + items beside an image, a before/after pair, or a three-column grid of titled items.
features.checklist.scope: Solution pages, plus company and product-landing pages that use the split variant (24 routes across the templates that list it).

features.tabs-light.description: Light centred tab row with an underline on the active tab; each tab shows a short description and one square image.

social-proof.stats-bento.description: Dark 'trusted at scale' band: optional eyebrow, heading, and four blur-dark cards in an alternating 7+5 / 5+7 bento, each with eyebrow, stat heading, body and an optional image or logo-tile row.
social-proof.stats-bento.scope: Solution, industry, form and product-landing pages, plus one data-platform member (29 routes across the templates that list it).

article.story-header.description: Case-study header: H1, customer logo and a row of headline stats.

article.story-body.description: Prose column (8 cols) of chapters, each opened by an h3, beside a bordered facts card (logo, labelled facts). Prose blocks: paragraphs, headings, lists, quotes, images, tables. One DOM unit; decompose logically by chapter (h3).
article.story-body.scope: Single-template section (4 routes across the templates that list it).

article.related-stories.description: Mono eyebrow, heading-2 and three bordered story cards (logo, heading-4 title link, summary, chevron link).
article.related-stories.scope: Single-template section (4 routes across the templates that list it).

listing.header.description: Plain listing header: H1 only, no buttons or media.
listing.header.scope: Hub listings and filterable card-grid listings (7 routes across the templates that list it).

listing.category-nav.description: Blurred pill navigation linking to category sub-listings, with a search input beside it.

listing.hub-grid.description: Stack of category blocks (gap 120): optional heading-3 + 'browse all' link, an optional featured row (16:9 image half + title half) and a 3-up card grid; may contain one inline gradient promo card.
listing.hub-grid.scope: Single-template section (3 routes across the templates that list it).

listing.case-grid.description: Filters menu button + search field, a 3-column grid of 6 bordered case cards, a featured-story band (quote card over a brush stroke), 6 more cards and a View more button; a no-results state replaces the grid.
listing.case-grid.scope: Single-template section (4 routes across the templates that list it).

listing.event-grid.description: Single-select region dropdown (writes ?filter=) and a search field above a 3-column grid of event cards (16:9 image, region chip, title, date); a text no-results block replaces the grid.
listing.event-grid.scope: Single-template section (4 routes across the templates that list it).

listing.session-grid.description: Event dropdown and search above a 3-column grid of session cards (21 per page, View more adds 21); a filter or search change shows 3 pulsing skeleton cards for ~1.2s before the result.
listing.session-grid.scope: Single-template section (4 routes across the templates that list it).

listing.press-grid.description: Centred heading-2, a 3-column grid of up to 21 press cards and a primary View more button (+21).
listing.press-grid.scope: Single-template section (4 routes across the templates that list it).

article.progress-bar.description: Fixed top-of-viewport 6px track whose purple fill width follows the page scroll fraction. Rendered as the first child of the post page; no transition.
article.progress-bar.scope: Single-template section (4 routes across the templates that list it).

article.post-body.description: One white section (py 64): breadcrumb, H1, author row and 'last edited' line, then prose chapters (each opened by an h2) in 8/12 columns beside a rail (3/12, 80 gap) of sticky promos and a sticky share bar. One DOM unit; decompose logically by chapter (h2).
article.post-body.scope: Single-template section (4 routes across the templates that list it).

listing.latest-posts.description: Heading-3 above three compact blog cards (16:9 image, tag + read time, title, author row).
listing.latest-posts.scope: Single-template section (4 routes across the templates that list it).

article.guide-header.description: Hero-style header for long-form guides and reports: H1, author link, a download button and a second CTA.
article.guide-header.scope: Articles (guide and report members) (4 routes across the template that lists it).

article.guide-body.description: Prose chapters (2/3, each opened by an h2) beside a sticky rail (1/4: table of contents with scroll-spy, then one promo). The report variant ends the prose with an embedded download form card. One DOM unit; decompose logically by chapter (h2).
article.guide-body.scope: Single-template section (4 routes across the templates that list it).

form.form-header.description: Two-column page header: copy (eyebrow, H1, intro, optional sub-sections or logo row) beside a static form panel with privacy fine print; some members have only a button in place of the form. No submission.
form.form-header.scope: Asset/webinar landings and form pages (7 routes across the templates that list it).

social-proof.logo-bar.description: Static 'trusted by' row: centred small heading above a single wrapping row of about six customer wordmarks; no motion (distinct from the homepage marquee).
social-proof.logo-bar.scope: Asset/webinar landings and product landings (12 routes across the templates that list it).

legal.policy-header.description: Policy page header: H1 only. Absent on one member, which starts directly with a section heading.
legal.policy-header.scope: Legal/policy pages (3 routes across the template that lists it).

legal.policy-body.description: 832-wide centred prose column of heading-bounded parts (each h2 or h3 opens a chapter wrapper): headings, paragraphs with inline markup, lists, tables. One DOM unit; decompose logically by heading-bounded part.
legal.policy-body.scope: Single-template section (3 routes across the templates that list it).

company.compliance-rows.description: Centred heading above stacked rows of a certification badge (left quarter) and a heading + prose description (right three quarters).
company.compliance-rows.scope: Company/program pages (security member) (10 routes across the template that lists it).

company.leadership-list.description: Centred heading above a vertical list of large bordered person cards: round avatar, name, role line, profile link and a short bio.
company.leadership-list.scope: Company/program pages (about member) (10 routes across the template that lists it).

company.people-grid.description: Centred heading above a wrapping row of avatar + name + role tiles (no bio).
company.people-grid.scope: Company/program pages (about member) (10 routes across the template that lists it).

company.program-list.description: Two-column block: heading, paragraphs and button on the left; a list of icon + title + paragraph + tertiary button program items on the right.
company.program-list.scope: Company/program pages (certification member) (10 routes across the template that lists it).

company.role-list.description: Open roles grouped by department: tag chip per group, then rows of role title link, location with pin icon and an apply button.
company.role-list.scope: Company/program pages (careers member) (10 routes across the template that lists it).

editorial.community-bento.description: Dark bento of community updates: a wide feature card with square image, a member quote card, a meetup date card, a topics list card and an image-of-the-week card.
editorial.community-bento.scope: Company/program pages (community member) (10 routes across the template that lists it).

editorial.dark-news-strip.description: Compact dark strip: eyebrow, heading and paragraph on the left, one outlined light button on the right; no lockup (differs from the homepage news band).
editorial.dark-news-strip.scope: Company/program pages (careers member) (10 routes across the template that lists it).

interactive.course-tabs.description: Text column (eyebrow, heading, paragraph, button) beside a light flex-grow tab row whose panels list course cards (16:9 image, tag + duration, title, paragraph, chevron link).
interactive.course-tabs.scope: Company/program pages (learning member) (10 routes across the template that lists it).

interactive.faq-accordion.description: Centred heading (+ optional paragraph) above grey rounded accordion items: question row with plus/minus glyph, instant independent expand/collapse revealing prose.
interactive.faq-accordion.scope: Company pages, product landings and pricing (20 routes across the templates that list it).

interactive.photo-tabs.description: Left-aligned header and button above a flex-grow light tab row; each panel is a mirrored mosaic of one large and two small square photos per column.
interactive.photo-tabs.scope: Company/program pages (community member) (10 routes across the template that lists it).

cta.dev-path-dialog.description: Modal dialog opened by some hero buttons: dimmed blurred overlay, white panel with close button, heading, then rows of path title + description + secondary button divided by hairlines. Overlay, not an in-flow section.
cta.dev-path-dialog.scope: Opened from hero buttons on company and product-landing pages (19 routes across the templates that list it).
cta.dev-path-dialog.implementedBy: src/components/sections/DevModal.jsx > DevModalButton (opened via parts.jsx > Btn when cta.dialog is set)

comparison.compare-table.description: Left-aligned heading above a two-option feature table: zebra rows, check marks or info notes per cell, outlined rounded body; repeats once per feature group.
comparison.compare-table.scope: Product landings (self-hosted comparison member) (9 routes across the template that lists it).

comparison.journey-columns.description: Dark band of four maturity columns (three outlined, the last highlighted with a glow) listing labelled facts, status badges and x/check lists, with a decorative curve overlay.
comparison.journey-columns.scope: Product landings (self-hosted comparison member) (9 routes across the template that lists it).

features.integration-strip.description: Centred grey kicker and heading above a single wrapping row of square icon-only integration tiles and one button; tiles darken their border on hover.

interactive.install-tabs.description: Centred header above a two-tab light tablist; each panel is a bordered card holding one shell-command row (prompt glyph, monospace command, copy button).

interactive.persona-tabs.description: Centred icon tabs (one per persona); each panel shows a before card and an after card side by side, each with a code chip, heading and bullet list.

pricing.plan-cards.description: Pricing header that holds the H1 above a row of plan cards (plan name, price block, feature list, button).
pricing.plan-cards.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

pricing.add-ons.description: Light band of two add-on offer cards below the plans.
pricing.add-ons.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

comparison.plan-matrix.description: Multi-plan feature comparison table with collapsible feature groups and icon cells, one column per plan.
comparison.plan-matrix.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

hero.champions-dark.description: Near-black full-width community-program header with the page's own display face; opens the dark-theme sequence.
hero.champions-dark.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

community.about-band.description: Dark about-the-program band following the dark hero.
community.about-band.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

community.member-grid.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

community.icon-cards.description: Heading-2 with optional eyebrow and paragraph above a row of borderless icon items (icon, heading-4, paragraph); light 5-column or dark 4-column.
community.icon-cards.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

community.dark-quote.description: One static 48/57.6 quote on #030711 with a 40px round avatar and attribution; nine stepped orange bars at the right (>=1024). A single quote, not a slider.
community.dark-quote.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

community.story-slider.description: Eyebrow, heading-2 and paragraph above a draggable slider of 12 square-cornered story cards (16:9 image, type label, 24/33 title, byline, text button); arrows below. A slider, not a grid.
community.story-slider.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

cta.champions-closing.description: Dark closing band inviting the visitor to join the champions program, in the page's dark theme.
cta.champions-closing.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

shell.event-subnav.description: Transparent event-specific navigation bar (event name plus agenda, speakers, experience, tour and waitlist links) that replaces the global navbar and mega-menus; uses the event's own display face.
shell.event-subnav.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

hero.event.description: Event microsite header in the event's display face, sitting under the event sub-nav.
hero.event.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

event.photo-gallery.description: Large photo gallery from past editions of the event.
event.photo-gallery.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

event.recap.description: Recap block summarising the previous edition.
event.recap.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

event.highlight-rows.description: Display heading-2 above a list of rows separated by black hairlines: a pixel icon, a display title and an outlined button per row. Rows, not cards.
event.highlight-rows.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

event.sponsor-logos.description: Grid of sponsor marks (placeholder marks only in the clone).
event.sponsor-logos.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

event.photo-band.description: One full-container photo (object-cover, positioned 50% 74%), 560 tall (320 below 768). A single image, not a media block with text.
event.photo-band.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

event.quote-band.description: Black band with a purple pixel-dither strip on top, a display-size quote and mono name + role lines.
event.quote-band.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

event.closing-band.description: Black closing band: display heading (two lines) left, paragraph and an outlined button right (bottom-aligned).
event.closing-band.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

shell.event-footer.description: Chrome 'event': replaces the global footer. Giant event wordmark with a link block overlaid at >=768, a pixel-tile strip (dither, heat band, checker) and a citron tagline/copyright bar.
shell.event-footer.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

shell.minimal-nav.description: Minimal white navigation row: brand mark and a single Home link; no menus, search or CTAs.
shell.minimal-nav.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

directory.header.description: Page-opening header of the partner locator: centred 48/57.6 H1 and a paragraph in a 684 column. Classified DIRECTORY, not HERO.
directory.header.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).

directory.partner-locator.description: Static mock of a partner locator: filter sidebar (collapsible facet groups with counts, selected-facet chips), search field, top and bottom pagination and a 3-column grid of partner cards (wordmark, name, url line, clamped text, tier badge). Filters AND across groups, OR inside a group; 9 cards per page.
directory.partner-locator.scope: Single-template section (1 routes across the templates that list it).
